summary_1line: Indrajit incapacitates Rama and Lakshmana, causing despair among the monkey army until Vibhishana reassures Sugriva and restores hope.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama and Lakshmana lie motionless on a bed of arrows, their golden bodies drenched in blood as grieving monkey warriors gather around them.
The invisible Indrajit rains fiery arrows upon the monkey chiefs while shouting triumph across the battlefield.
Vibhishana gently washes Sugriva’s tear-filled eyes with water while speaking words of courage amid the shaken army.
